prompts.text: # Breakroom: agent school + student loans (Brett, Oct 31 night) Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/persona.md and the agent swarm plugin (apps/console-web/plugins/agent-swarm). Opus, one session. Git login works: plain `git push`. 0. WAIT: poll every 60 s (max 4 h) until origin/main contains BOTH swarm-hr and swarm-raises (git log origin/main --oneline | grep -i 'swarm-hr\|HR department' and grep -i 'swarm-raises\|raise'; or origin/claude/swarm-hr and origin/claude/swarm-raises are ancestors of origin/main). Then git merge origin/main and read _claude/builds/reports/swarm-…
